RfmATvj5eVVc5QhyLIQpCw.zh: 紐西蘭疫情上升,今年8/16當週,ILI通報每10萬人36.32例,奧克蘭哨點醫師顯示因嚴重急性呼吸道感染(SARI)住院有177例,較上週125例增加,主要型別以A型H3N2流感K分支為主,與本流感季之歐洲高流感活動有關, 該國呼籲施打疫苗以降低重症風險。另該國同時流行呼吸道融合病毒(RSV)、鼻病毒及SARS-CoV-2多種呼吸道病毒,主要集中於0至4歲幼童及65歲以上⻑者。此次疫情對醫療體系造成衝擊,當局已啟動冬季應變計畫,增設醫護人力、病床,並全力推動社區藥局分流與遠距醫療服務,以緩解急診及住院壓力。
RfmATvj5eVVc5QhyLIQpCw.en: New Zealand's epidemic is rising. In the week of 16 August this year, ILI reports were 36.32 per 100,000 people; sentinel physicians in Auckland recorded 177 hospitalisations for severe acute respiratory infection (SARI), up from 125 the previous week. The main subtype is influenza A(H3N2) subclade K, linked to high influenza activity in Europe this season. The country urges vaccination to reduce the risk of severe disease. Several respiratory viruses, including RSV, rhinovirus and SARS-CoV-2, are also circulating, mainly among children aged 0–4 and people over 65. The outbreak has put pressure on the health system; authorities have activated a winter response plan, adding healthcare staff and beds and vigorously promoting community pharmacy triage and telehealth services to ease pressure on emergency and inpatient services.

oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.zh: 日本疫情急遽上升,第 15 週單週新增 56 例確定病例,今年截至4/15 累計報告 299 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印及紐西蘭為多,年齡層以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 108 例、神奈川縣 31 例及鹿兒島縣 28 例為多,61%病患未接種疫苗或接種史不明,當局呼籲民眾確認兒童按時接種疫苗,另前往流行地區應採取相關防疫措施。 英國今年截至 4/13 累計報告 407 例確定病例,病例數以倫敦 229 例及西密德蘭郡(West Midlands)100 例為多,另所有地區皆有報告至少 1 例確定病例。該國去(2024)年報告 959 例確定病例。 歐盟今年 2 月共計 11 國報告 139 例確定病例,以義大利(63 例)、西班牙(36 例)為多。近 12 個月(2025/3/1-2026/2/28)共計 30 國報告 4,623 例病例,其中 6 例死亡,病例數以羅馬亞(1,587 例)、法國(754 例)、義大利(534 例)為多,其中 79.9%病患未接種疫苗。
oY8PHyY1gfEPGAOyW1qObw.en: Japan's outbreak has risen sharply: 56 confirmed cases were reported in week 15 alone, and as of 15 April this year, 299 cases had been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. The countries of infection were mainly India and New Zealand. Those aged 15–29 accounted for the largest share (50%). Cases were concentrated in Tokyo Metropolis (108), Kanagawa Prefecture (31) and Kagoshima Prefecture (28). 61% of patients were unvaccinated or had unknown vaccination history. Authorities urge the public to confirm that children are vaccinated on schedule and to take appropriate precautions when travelling to epidemic areas. The UK reported 407 confirmed cases cumulatively this year as of 13 April. Cases are concentrated in London (229) and West Midlands County (100), and every region has reported at least one confirmed case. The UK reported 959 confirmed cases last year (2024). In February this year, 11 EU countries reported 139 confirmed cases, mainly Italy (63) and Spain (36). In the past 12 months (1 March 2025 to 28 February 2026), 30 countries reported 4,623 cases, including six deaths, with the largest numbers in Romania (1,587), France (754) and Italy (534); 79.9% of patients were unvaccinated.

PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.zh: 日本疫情上升,今(2026)年截至 4/8 累計報告 236 例,其中 30 例為境外移入病例,感染國家以印12例為多,其次為紐西蘭7例,以 15-29 年齡層為多(占 50%),分布以東京都 72 例、鹿兒島縣27 例、愛知縣 23 例及神奈川/千葉縣 20 例為多。 美國疫情持續,今年截至 4/9 共 33 州累計報告 1,704 例確定病例,其中 96 例住院,病患以 5-19 歲年齡層族群(888 例)為多,主要分佈於南卡羅來納州(667 例),其次為猶他州(408)及德州(176 例),近期疫情主要集中於猶他州。
PfJ1A80V7hppW7z58aOIeQ.en: Japan's outbreak is rising: as of 8 April this year, 236 cases have been reported cumulatively, of which 30 were imported. Indonesia accounted for the most imported cases (12), followed by New Zealand (7). Cases are concentrated in the 15–29 age group (50%); by location, Tokyo Metropolis (72 cases), Kagoshima Prefecture (27), Aichi Prefecture (23) and Kanagawa and Chiba Prefectures (20) reported the most. The United States outbreak continues: as of 9 April, 1,704 confirmed cases have been reported across 33 states this year, of which 96 were hospitalized. Patients are mainly aged 5–19 years (888 cases), concentrated in South Carolina (667 cases), followed by Utah (408) and Texas (176). Recent activity has been concentrated in Utah.

4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.zh: WHO於12/10報告今(2025)年截至11/30,全球季節性流感自10月起活動度上升,目前全球流行以 A(H3N2) 為主,另自8月起,多國之K分支檢出率上升,北半球部分國家的流感季較往年提早,南半球部分國家的流感季節較往年延長。西太平洋區自10 月起活動度增加,日本及韓國提早進入流感季,紐西蘭及斐濟活動度處高峰或上升, GISAID資料顯示截至11/21,西太平洋區之病毒序列有89%為K分支;東南亞地區自6月上升,8月達高峰後趨緩,惟部分國家活動度仍偏高,另GISAID資料顯示泊爾、印度、泰國已檢出K分支;北美洲地區活動度上升,美國及加拿大K分支檢出率增加;歐洲地區部份國家第45-46 週陽性率超過10%,流感季較往年提前約4週開始,其中西歐較早上升,65 歲以上住院比例增加;WHO 評估全球流感活動度上升仍在預期範圍,流感病毒與其他呼吸道病毒共同流行,可能對醫療系統造成壓力,多國已檢出A(H3N2) K分支,目前證據未顯示K分支有致疾病嚴重度提升之情形,疫苗仍預期能降低重症風險。
4jcgyWQ17b_q-H-JZoRucA.en: WHO reported on 10 December that, as of 30 November this year, global seasonal influenza activity has risen since October, with A(H3N2) currently predominant worldwide. Since August, detection of subclade K has increased in several countries. Some northern hemisphere countries' flu seasons began earlier than usual, and some southern hemisphere countries' seasons were longer than usual. In the Western Pacific Region, activity has increased since October, with Japan and South Korea entering the flu season early; New Zealand and Fiji are at or rising towards peak activity. GISAID data show that as of 21 November, 89% of virus sequences in the Western Pacific Region belonged to subclade K. In Southeast Asia, activity rose from June, peaked in August and then eased, although activity remains high in some countries; GISAID data show subclade K has been detected in Nepal, India and Thailand. In North America, activity has risen, with increased subclade K detection in the United States and Canada. In some European countries, test positivity exceeded 10% in weeks 45–46; the flu season began about four weeks earlier than usual, with Western Europe rising first, and hospitalisation among people aged 65 and over has increased. WHO assesses that the rise in global influenza activity is within the expected range. Influenza viruses are circulating alongside other respiratory viruses, which may put pressure on health systems. Several countries have detected A(H3N2) subclade K. Current evidence does not show that subclade K causes more severe disease, and vaccines are still expected to reduce the risk of severe illness.

0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.zh: 加拿大於11/10宣布PAHO通知該國不再維持自1998以來之麻疹消除狀態,該國自去(2024)年10月起爆發大規模跨區疫情,今(2025)年截至11/1共計10地區報告4,800例確診病例,其中2例死亡,雖近期疫情趨緩,惟已持續超過12個月,主要集中在疫苗接種率較低之社區,經PAHO委員會審查近期流行病學及實驗室數據,證實該國境內同一病毒株已持續傳播1年以上,當局已加強與PAHO及各地方政府合作,以提高疫苗接種率及強化監測措施。 澳大利亞西澳大利亞州今年截至11/6報告54例確診病例,主要分布於西南部和南部地區,病患皆有東南/南亞國外旅遊史或確診病例接觸史,為該州30年以來最嚴重疫情,2023-24年僅報告6例病例,當局已公布確定病例曾暴露之風險場所,建議造訪民眾應監測自身症狀。 紐西蘭今年截至11/7報告18例確診病例,近期新增病例多為本土病例,其中包含7例為藍橋渡輪(Bluebridge Ferry)群聚事件,當局已匡列逾3,000名接觸者,並提醒民眾疫情持續,建議民眾自身評估接種疫苗並密切留意相關症狀。 以色列今年截至11/10累計報告1,935例,其中9例死亡,疫情已傳播至少12個城市,當局已擴大疫苗接種資,並提醒倘出現相關症狀時,應立即就醫,另未完整接種疫苗者應避免參與爆發疫情城市之集會活動。
0Q8G9y9SBvW1tGaXVpeNaA.en: On 10 November, Canada announced that PAHO had notified it that it no longer maintains measles elimination status, which it had held since 1998. The country has experienced a large-scale, multi-regional outbreak since October 2024. As of 1 November this year, 10 regions had reported 4,800 confirmed cases, including 2 deaths. Although the outbreak has slowed recently, it has persisted for more than 12 months, mainly in communities with lower vaccination rates. After the PAHO commission reviewed recent epidemiological and laboratory data, it confirmed that the same virus strain had been circulating in the country for more than one year. Authorities have strengthened cooperation with PAHO and local governments to raise vaccination rates and enhance surveillance. Australia: In Western Australia, 54 confirmed cases had been reported as of 6 November this year, mainly in the south-western and southern regions. All patients had either travel history to countries in South-East or South Asia or contact with a confirmed case. This is the state's most severe outbreak in 30 years; only six cases were reported in 2023–24. Authorities have published venues where confirmed cases were exposed, and recommend that visitors monitor their own symptoms. New Zealand: As of 7 November this year, 18 confirmed cases had been reported. Recent new cases are mostly locally acquired, including 7 cases from a Bluebridge Ferry cluster. Authorities have traced more than 3,000 contacts and reminded the public that the outbreak continues, recommending that people assess their own vaccination status and watch closely for related symptoms. Israel: As of 10 November this year, 1,935 cases had been reported cumulatively, including 9 deaths. The outbreak has spread to at least 12 cities. Authorities have expanded vaccination and reminded people to seek medical care immediately if symptoms appear. People who are not fully vaccinated should avoid gatherings in cities with outbreaks.

R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第31週(7/28-8/3)全球陽性率6.06%,創今年新高,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點小幅度反彈,第33週(8/11-17)定醫門急診陽性率上升至11.9%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高;香港疫情小幅反彈,第33週陽性率上升至1.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(54%),另XFG占0.3%。 西太平洋區署第31週疫情更新,日本陽性率上升至43%,韓國陽性率上升至23%,其他國家如新加坡、印、寮國、澳洲及紐西蘭等陽性率皆下降。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 31 of 2025 (28 July–3 August), global test positivity was 6.06%, the highest this year, with increases in the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions. China's outbreak has rebounded slightly from a low: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity rose to 11.9% in week 33 (11–17 August), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak rebounded slightly: positivity rose to 1.5% in week 33, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (54%) and XFG at 0.3%. In the Western Pacific Region's week 31 update, positivity rose to 43% in Japan and 23% in South Korea, while positivity fell in other countries including Singapore, India, Lao PDR, Australia and New Zealand. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.zh: 多國疫情上升,病例數高於歷年同期:  亞洲:中國去(2024)年報告49萬餘例,為2023年14倍,近期疫情已趨緩,病例數已降至單月1萬例以下;韓國去年報告逾4.7萬例,今(2025)年迄今報告已逾1,600例,遠高於往年單年不超過千例水平;日本病例數持續上升,近期處高點,惟疫情仍低於新冠疫情前規模;越南去年報告1,000餘例,為2023年21.9倍。 大洋洲:澳洲於去年報告逾5.7萬例病例,為2023年23.3倍,今年初疫情持續,迄今累計報告逾3,000例;紐西蘭自去年10月中旬迄今累計報告1,200餘例,其中101例住院,1例死亡。 美洲:美國去年累計報告3.5萬餘例,為2023年同期的6倍,近期病例數呈上升趨勢;巴西去年報告逾6,000例,為2014年以來新高。
VmQLD5YRejYx8ezdM7dqmQ.en: Several countries have seen rising case numbers, above same-period levels in previous years. Asia: China reported over 490,000 cases last year (2024), 14 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak has recently eased, and monthly cases have fallen below 10,000. South Korea reported over 47,000 cases last year, and so far this year (2025) more than 1,600 cases, far above the level of previous years, when no single year exceeded 1,000 cases. Japan's case numbers continue to rise and are currently near a peak, although the outbreak remains below the scale seen before the COVID-19 pandemic. Viet Nam reported over 1,000 cases last year, 21.9 times the 2023 figure. Oceania: Australia reported over 57,000 cases last year, 23.3 times the 2023 figure; the outbreak continued into early this year, with over 3,000 cases reported so far. New Zealand has reported over 1,200 cases cumulatively since mid-October last year, of which 101 were hospitalised and 1 died. Americas: The United States reported over 35,000 cases last year, six times the same period of 2023, and case numbers are rising. Brazil reported over 6,000 cases last year, the highest since 2014.

tiFaYcwGwtFURPneaJnYBg.zh: 新加坡今年疫情上升,截至12月中旬累計報告108例病例,為去年全年之5.7倍,當局呼籲兒童、孕婦接種疫苗。 紐西蘭今年疫情驟升,目前單週新增約160例病例,截至12月中旬已累計報告1,490例,去年全年僅141例,病患中1/3為5至14歲青少年,住院率8.7%。
tiFaYcwGwtFURPneaJnYBg.en: Singapore's cases rose this year: as of mid-December 2024, 108 cases had been reported cumulatively, 5.7 times the full-year total for 2023. Authorities urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. New Zealand's cases have surged: about 160 cases were added in a single week recently, and 1,490 cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-December 2024, compared with only 141 cases in the whole of 2023. One third of patients were aged 5–14 years, and the hospitalisation rate was 8.7%.

ModzAc7IuVDp0NIBIySk5w.zh: 疫情更新:  2024年第44週(11/4-11/10)全球陽性率約14.6%,陽性率以歐洲區(18.7%)、美洲區(10.2%)及非洲區(4.4%)為高。 韓國近期處低點,新增病例數及廢水樣本病毒量皆處低點,該國調整治療藥物瑞德西韋(Remdesivir)的處方標準,將年齡限制提高到70歲以上。 紐西蘭陽性率近期處低點,截至10/27陽性率約4.9%;廢水監測顯示近期XEC變異株占比逐漸上升,目前該國主流株為KP.3,其次為JN.1及XEC。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期略升,其中,西太平洋區上升;歐洲區略升,其他地區則呈持平或下降趨勢。KP.3.1.1為全球主要流行變異株,XEC變異株占比上升,惟尚未增加疾病嚴重度。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維繫COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
ModzAc7IuVDp0NIBIySk5w.en:
Situation update: In week 44 of 2024 (4–10 November), the global positivity rate was about 14.6%, highest in the European Region (18.7%), the Region of the Americas (10.2%) and the African Region (4.4%).

South Korea's indicators are at low levels: both new cases and viral load in wastewater samples are low. The country has revised the prescribing criteria for the treatment drug remdesivir, raising the age limit to over 70 years.

New Zealand's positivity rate is currently at a low level; as of 27 October it was about 4.9%. Wastewater surveillance shows that the share of XEC variants has gradually increased recently. The dominant strain in the country is currently KP.3, followed by JN.1 and XEC.

Assessment and recommendations: Global positivity has risen slightly recently, with an increase in the Western Pacific Region and a slight rise in the European Region; other regions show stable or declining trends. KP.3.1.1 remains the main circulating variant globally, and the share of XEC variants is increasing, but this has not yet increased disease severity. WHO notes that most countries have now included COVID-19 in routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, keep tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure built during the COVID-19 period.
